description: Deterministic baseline vectors for the ZeroCoin Rust implementation.
determinism: no wall clock, RNG, wallet, data directory or network is used
keys are the published scalars 1 and 2, plus the crate's repeated-byte [9u8; 32]
block timestamps are the literals 1700000000 + height and GENESIS_TIMESTAMP
JSON object keys are emitted in sorted order by serde_json
notes: Every case except the pinned constants in chain/anchors.json and the `difficulty.params`, `pow.engine_ids` and `reward.constants` cases is recomputed from its inputs by test/harness/zro_vectors.py; those five cannot be recomputed from an input and are reported as ANCHOR, not PASS.
Private values in crypto/addresses.json are published test scalars, never wallet keys.
provenance: zerocoin/ Rust sources; the introducing commit is `git log --follow test/vectors/manifest.json`
